programs.desc: Reviews of The Abyss, Mystery Train, Do the Right Thing and Cappuccino. Interview with Tony Bowman on Cappuccino. Mentions of Oliver and Co and Prancer.

programs.title: Forever Enthralled
programs.desc: Set in the artistic underground of 1930s China, this is the epic story of Mei Lanfang - the performer who overcame prejudice to become China's greatest opera star.

programs.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programs.desc: 1943, The war is entering its final stages and Germany is teetering on the brink of defeat. An increasingly unhinged Hitler, orders a mission to have British Prime Minister Winston Churchill kidnapped and brought to Germany. The plan seems ludicrous in the extreme, but a message sent from a German spy in the Norfolk countryside makes one German officer realize that such a mission may just be feasible.

programs.title: Little Loves
programs.desc: Teresa, 42, changes her vacation plans to help her mother, who has had a minor accident. Their forced coexistence brings revealing moments for both.

programs.title: The Idol
programs.desc: Mohammad Assaf, an aspiring musician living in Gaza, sets a seemingly impossible goal: to compete on the program 'Arab Idol'.

programs.title: Discovering Film
programs.desc: A look at the life and career of the the Academy Award-winning actor whose glittering portfolio includes Norma Rae, Places in the Heart, Mrs Doubtfire and Forrest Gump.
